note: src/core/Vparser.c is six bytes of .text, so the mutation surface is genuinely small: the only two things either function does are return zero and not write. Both are broken here in both functions. There is nothing else to mutate -- a stub has no arithmetic, no branch and no state -- which is why this set is four entries and not thirty, and why t_vparser can be complete rather than representative. The other half of the claim, that the CALL SEQUENCE in loadParams is right, is v90loadparams.json and v92loadparams.json; those two run against a binary that weakens these stubs out, so this is the only set that reaches the bodies.
